items.title: The Cardboard Box Invention Club | Imagination Story for Kids
story_beats: Three children find one large clean cardboard box and agree to build together.
They draw wheels and transform it into a bus, then steer and signal as the scenery travels.
They open flaps into a cave, crawl carefully, and discover friendly painted wall shapes.
They cut a grown-up-prepared window and create a puppet theatre with an original tiny show.
They add cushions and books, turning the same box into a calm reading nook.
The finale reveals all four ideas around the decorated box and celebrates shared imagination.
